claim_rules: CPU fallback=0 means the GGML scheduler did not move nodes to another backend; it does not prove that the HETERO backend avoided host CPU execution.
The 958-node graph is received as one split, but the current graph_compute implementation invokes one monolithic software submission.
The 588 Command128 records are bound and validated; they are not yet executed one-by-one by the RTL command frontend in this path.
338 canonical payload files match; 57 are explicit F32-to-BF16 RNE conversions, so raw GGUF storage byte parity is 281.
The seven random stalls apply to layer completion callback acceptance, not internal engine ready/valid paths.
Top-10 and argmax agreement do not replace a full-logit metric report.
